SELECT a.AUTH_NO, a.MEMBER_NO, a.MEMBER_ID, a.MEMBER_PWD, m.MEMBER_NAME, m.EMAIL, m.PHONE, m.BIRTHDAY, m.IMAGE, m.MEMBER_ROLE, m.ENROLL_DATE, NVL(d.DELETE_STATUS, 'N') AS DELETE_STATUS FROM TB_AUTHENTICATION a JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON a.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_DELETED_MEMBER d ON a.MEMBER_NO = d.MEMBER_NO WHERE a.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND NVL(d.DELETE_STATUS, 'N') = 'N'
